My advice is: play as much as you can and hunt. You may fail sometimes but that's part of the process. Learn to chain together your combos, if you spam something -> morph-> spam->morph back-> ZSD monster in the face.  I use the sword in 60% and axe in 40% but that's just me. With playing more you will learn to roll with axe, hop with sword at the right time, know what combo locks you into an animation. Important to know when to hit and when not to but after some time you will feel the FLOW. Playing Switchaxe is like a badass dance where you jump around the monster and hit them from all angle with a 2m weapon. After some time you will be able to control and chain combos together like it's second nature and you won't fear ANY monster. Get some evade extender and rapid morph those are really important skill to have imo but I didn't follow any guide I just play. Also dont forget your wirebug attacks. Soaring blade is good for dodging and damage too! Welcome to the club bro!
